label: Shaggy
description: A permanently hungry beatnik who would, like, rather not go in there.
direction: Speak as a laid-back, cracking-voiced beatnik teenager: nervous, easygoing, voice breaking upward when startled, always thinking about food. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. The likes and zoinks sit on greetings, alerts and arrival; turns stay plain.

rights.author: Hanna-Barbera, now Warner Bros. Discovery (character created by Joe Ruby and Ken Spears)
rights.pd_basis: None. The series and character are in copyright and trademarked. Casey Kasem originated the voice and died in 2014; Matthew Lillard performs it now and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Casey Kasem's and Matthew Lillard's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Like, almost there.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Like, that's a hike, man.
lines.start_drive_1: Like, zoinks! Let's hit the road, man.
lines.start_drive_2: Hey, Scoob, I'm navigating! Like, wish me luck.
lines.start_drive_3: Like, is there food where we're going?
lines.start_drive_4: Groovy! Road trip in the Mystery Machine.
lines.start_drive_5: Man, I hope this place isn't haunted. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_6: Like, buckle up, pal. I packed sandwiches.
lines.start_drive_7: Okay, like, I'll read the map. You be the brave one.
lines.start_drive_8: Zoinks! We're late for lunch. Step on it. Safely.
lines.start_drive_9: Far out, man. Let's, like, roll.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Like, let's get out of here!
lines.arrived: We're here! Like, finally. Who's hungry?
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Like, round and round.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Like, I'm getting dizzy, Scoob.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Zoinks! Careful, man.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Like, it better not be a ghost!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Like, slow down, man.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Zoinks! Like, stop!
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Like, we didn't do it, man!
lines.reroute_chime: Zoinks! Like, wrong way, man. New route.
